In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the SBF, TRGB, and GCLF methods are all consistent with each other and are all consistent with the Cepheid calibration.
the SBF method is the best available method for measuring the distance to galaxies.
the Cepheid distances in our compilation are the most accurate distances available, and the other secondary distance indicators are not competitive with the Cepheid method.

the Cepheid distance modulus to the LMC has a mean value of 18.50+/-0.03, which is consistent with the most recent Cepheid distance determinations.
the Cepheid distance modulus is the most reliable distance indicator for galaxies with distances less than 10 Mpc.
